title: How to Reserve a Spot for an Event
content:
To reserve an event, open the CultPass app, browse the experience catalog, select the event, and tap 'Reserve'. Premium or limited events may require email confirmation. Arrive at least 15 minutes early with the QR code visible.

Suggested phrasing: You can reserve an experience in the CultPass app by selecting the event and tapping Reserve. Please arrive 15 minutes early with your QR code ready.

title: What's Included in a CultPass Subscription
content:
A CultPass subscription includes up to four curated cultural experiences each month, including art exhibitions, museum entries, music concerts, and film screenings. Premium experiences may require an additional fee displayed before reservation.

Suggested phrasing: Your CultPass plan includes four curated experiences each month. Any premium-event fee is shown before you reserve.

title: How to Cancel or Pause a Subscription
content:
Manage a subscription in the app under My Account > Manage Plan. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing cycle. Pausing preserves user data until the plan is reactivated. Do not offer a refund unless a support lead approves it.

Suggested phrasing: You can cancel or pause under My Account, then Manage Plan. Cancellation takes effect at the end of your billing cycle.

title: How to Handle Login Issues
content:
Most login issues are resolved with password reset. Tap Forgot Password on the login screen and use the registered email. If the reset email does not arrive, check spam and retry after 10 minutes. Escalate persistent login issues to human support.

Suggested phrasing: Tap Forgot Password and confirm that you are using your registered email. Check spam or retry after 10 minutes; if it still fails, support will investigate.

title: Troubleshooting a Failed Subscription Payment
content:
Confirm that the card number, expiry date, billing address, and available funds are correct. Retry once after updating payment details in My Account > Payment Methods. Do not repeatedly retry a declined card. If the bank continues to decline it, contact the card issuer.

Suggested phrasing: Please verify your card and billing details in Payment Methods, then retry once. If it is declined again, contact your card issuer.

title: Refund Review Policy
content:
Subscription refunds are not automatic. A support lead must review duplicate charges, verified service outages, or charges made after an effective cancellation. Event no-shows and change-of-mind requests are not normally refundable. Agents must escalate eligible cases with the charge date and amount.

Suggested phrasing: Refunds require support-lead review. I can escalate an eligible duplicate charge, verified outage, or post-cancellation charge with its date and amount.
tags: refund, billing, duplicate charge, cancellation, escalation

title: Change the Email Address on an Account
content:
A signed-in member can change their email under My Account > Personal Details. CultPass sends a verification link to the new address. If the member cannot sign in or no longer controls the old email, human support must verify identity before changing it.

Suggested phrasing: If you can sign in, update the address under Personal Details and verify the new email. Otherwise, support must verify your identity.

title: Blocked Account Review
content:
A blocked account cannot reserve experiences or change its plan. Do not disclose internal fraud signals or unblock it automatically. Confirm the registered email and escalate to the Trust and Safety team for review.

Suggested phrasing: This account needs a Trust and Safety review. I will pass along the registered account details without exposing security checks.
tags: account, blocked, security, escalation, trust safety

title: Missing or Invalid Event QR Code
content:
The event QR code appears in My Reservations after confirmation. Refresh the app and confirm that the reservation status is Reserved. If a valid reservation has no QR code within 30 minutes, sign out and back in once, then contact support before the event.

Suggested phrasing: Check My Reservations for a Reserved status and refresh the app. If the QR code is still missing after 30 minutes, sign out and back in once.
tags: reservation, qr code, ticket, technical, event

title: Cancel or Change an Event Reservation
content:
Open My Reservations, select the event, and tap Cancel. Cancellation must occur at least 24 hours before the event to restore the monthly quota. Reservations cannot be transferred to another member. A different date requires canceling and making a new reservation.

Suggested phrasing: Cancel from My Reservations at least 24 hours before the event to restore your quota, then reserve the new date.

title: Sold-Out Experiences and Waitlists
content:
When an experience is sold out, the Reserve button is replaced by Join Waitlist when a waitlist is available. Openings are offered in order and expire after two hours. Joining a waitlist does not use monthly quota until a place is confirmed.

Suggested phrasing: Select Join Waitlist if it is shown. An offered spot is held for two hours, and quota is used only after confirmation.
tags: reservation, sold out, waitlist, availability, quota

title: Accessibility Accommodations for Experiences
content:
Accessibility details appear on each experience page. Members can contact support before booking to request step-free access, seating, captioning, or other accommodations. Support confirms arrangements with the venue and never promises an accommodation before venue confirmation.

Suggested phrasing: Tell us the event and accommodation you need. We will confirm availability with the venue before promising the arrangement.

title: CultPass App Crashes or Freezes
content:
Update CultPass to the latest store version, fully close and reopen it, and restart the device. On Android, clear the app cache; do not clear storage. If the crash continues, collect the device model, operating-system version, app version, and the screen where it occurs, then escalate.

Suggested phrasing: Update and restart the app and device. If it still crashes, send your device, OS, app version, and the affected screen.

title: Manage Email and Push Notifications
content:
Notification preferences are under My Account > Notifications. Transactional messages such as reservation confirmations and security alerts cannot be disabled. Marketing email and event recommendations can be turned off independently.

Suggested phrasing: Open My Account, then Notifications. You can disable marketing and recommendations, while reservation and security messages remain enabled.

title: Request Account and Personal Data Deletion
content:
A member may request deletion under My Account > Privacy > Delete Account. The request requires email verification and enters a 30-day processing period. Legal or payment records may be retained where required. Identity disputes or urgent privacy incidents must be escalated to the Privacy team.

Suggested phrasing: Submit the request under Privacy, then Delete Account, and verify it by email. Processing can take 30 days.
tags: privacy, delete account, personal data, gdpr, account

title: Change App Language and Location
content:
Language and home location are available under My Account > Preferences. A location change updates nearby recommendations but does not move existing reservations. Some experiences are offered only in their listed city.

Suggested phrasing: Change language or home location under My Account, then Preferences. Existing reservations will not change.
